note: Disclosure for #7077 (class 2 scans only added lines), a deliberate gate change through issue and PR (#3156) built from the accepted arc (bound lean 7084665877). Class 2 of verify:class-checks now scans only the lines that one git diff -U0 --no-renames --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv against the candidate merge base marks as added, read with parseUnifiedDiffAddedLines. Injected callers pass the new optional ClassCheckOptions.addedLines; injected mode never reads git. A path with no added-line entry (untracked, binary, failed diff, injected without an entry) is scanned on every line, as before. No whitespace normalisation or line matching: a moved or re-indented reference line fails. The finding detail now names the first matching line. No change to which files count as production, the roots, needle regexes, class 1, 3 or 4, the same-PR policy-edit check, or verify:test-boundary. Tests change to pin the new contract. Disclosure only; not #3164 authorization. Refs #7077.
